activeForm: PERF (s515b, FILED for a ruling): print/say/printf are not in TOPIC_RAW_WORD, so `print {$fh} ... for 1..$n` boxes $_ per iteration -- the raw loop var is fhprint -27 %
description:
fhprint's fresh profile (s515b, main 973bdb1d): %make-p-box 16.6 % self / 18.9 cum -- ALL from
p-foreach-range's per-iteration (make-p-box i) for $_, because Parser2::_topic_raw_ok (#761) refuses any
Word not in %TOPIC_RAW_WORD and `print' is deliberately left out ("stringifying an operand can enter a `""'
overload handler, which is user code").  Hand-replaced (fhprint.lisp with p-foreach-range-raw): 0.271 ->
0.199 s whole process (-27 %), output identical.
The written reason is inconsistent with the list as it stands: `join' and `sprintf' ARE on it and
stringify their operands exactly as print does, and the RESIDUE note above _topic_raw_ok already accepts
an overload / tie handler reaching the global $_ as a documented residue (PCL_OPT=-raw-topic).  print adds
one route those two do not have: a TIED handle's PRINT method (user code) -- the same residue class as a
tied FETCH.  Ruling needed (Fable): add print/say/printf (not warn: $SIG{__WARN__}) to %TOPIC_RAW_WORD with
the residue note widened, or keep the exclusion.  An emission change (Parser2): generation bump +
corpus-diff + the three artifacts.  Probe a body that prints to a tied handle whose PRINT does `$_ = 9'
under perl first.


RULED s516 (Fable, 2026-10-12): YES -- print, say and printf join %TOPIC_RAW_WORD.  The written reason for leaving them out (a `""` overload handler is user code) already applies to join and sprintf, which ARE on the list; the one route print adds, a TIED handle's PRINT method reading the global $_, is the same residue class as a tied FETCH, which the RESIDUE note above _topic_raw_ok accepts with PCL_OPT=-raw-topic as the escape.  Conditions for the perf round 47 member: (1) the docstring / RESIDUE note names the tied-PRINT route explicitly and docs/not-supported.md's raw-topic residue entry gains the sentence; (2) a guard row: `print {$fh} $_ for 1..3` with a plain handle = perl, AND a tied handle whose PRINT reads the GLOBAL $_ -- perl-probed, the divergence shown under the default and gone under PCL_OPT=-raw-topic (the inverse guard, the residue made visible, never silent); (3) bench fhprint base / tree / base (-27 % expected) + the control band; (4) `tools/corpus-diff.pl` -- every differing file is a print/say/printf topic loop -- and the four-population emission A/B RCDIFF 0.
